changes.summary: Optional boolean (default false) for whether universal logout is enabled for the organization.
No longer computed; optional only. Refresh no longer auto-populates or clears entries when the block is omitted from configuration.

Optional and computed list of outbound email domain_id and route_id pairs for queues with multiple outbound email addresses; when set, outbound_email_address must be set and must match one list entry.

Refresh no longer runs the consistency checker after read, avoiding read loops on large tables; nested defaults_to blocks are written with stable empty value, special, and values siblings to prevent null versus empty string perpetual diffs.

For RDS-type lists, entries are fetched into state only when configuration declares a non-empty entries block; omitting entries leaves state unchanged and avoids phantom diffs and full-list reads on refresh.

Plan validates that outbound_email_address is set and listed in all_outbound_email_addresses when that block is used; refresh preserves configured list order when the set of addresses matches the API.
Refresh preserves existing example_phrases in state when the API returns none, preventing perpetual diffs for dialects that do not round-trip example phrases on read.
Create and update send universal_logout to the organization authentication settings API.
Create and update include all_outbound_email_addresses in queue email media settings when configured.
Create assigns division_id on the initial create request instead of a follow-up move update.
After delete, the provider waits up to 10 minutes for a not-found response before completing destroy, up from 3 minutes.
Export resolves domain_id and route_id references for all_outbound_email_addresses and drops entries missing route_id from export output.
